# typst

Compile and inspect Typst documents through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/typst compile input.typ output.pdf

moonx cli/typst compile --pages=1 input.typ output.svg

moonx cli/typst eval '1 + 2'
```

Compile PDF, PNG, SVG, HTML or bundles; watch inputs, evaluate expressions, query elements and inspect fonts/configuration. Use help COMMAND for subcommand options.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--root DIR` | Configures the project root (for absolute paths) |
| `--input key=value`, `-i key=value` | Add a string key-value pair visible through `sys.inputs` |
| `--font-path DIR` | Adds additional directories that are recursively searched for fonts |
| `--ignore-system-fonts` | Ensures system fonts won't be searched, unless explicitly included via `--font-path` |
| `--features FEATURES` | Enables in-development features that may be changed or removed at any time |
| `--format FORMAT`, `-f FORMAT` | The format of the output file, inferred from the extension by default |
| `--pages PAGES` | Which pages to export. When unspecified, all pages are exported |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Compatible with the MoonBit 2026-11-17 toolchain.

- Packages and templates must already be installed locally. Network downloads, self-update, viewer opening, completion generation and timing traces are unsupported.
- HTML needs --features html; HTML watch also needs --no-serve. Compilation is single-threaded and watch performs full recompilation.
- Inputs, fonts and output may remain in memory. Canonicalization is lexical, local time defaults to UTC and full Rust Typst parity is not claimed. See LICENSE and NOTICE for upstream attribution.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
